question.text: Suppose ‘G’ is a connected, undirected graph, whose edges have positive weights. Let M be a minimum spanning Tree of this graph. We modify the graph by adding ‘6’ to the weight of each edge, which of the following is TRUE?

options.label: A
options.text: The order of edges added to minimum spanning tree using kruskal’s algorithm, will change.

options.label: B
options.text: The modification adds 6(|V| – 1) to the total weight of all spanning trees.

options.label: C
options.text: The order of edges added to minimum spanning tree using prim’s algorithm, will change.

answer.correctText: The modification adds 6(|V| – 1) to the total weight of all spanning trees.
answer.explanation:
The order of edges added to minimum spanning tree does not change, because we are adding same weight to all the edges.
To the total weight we have to add 6(V – 1), because in a spanning tree, there will be (V – 1) edges, For every edge additional weight ‘6’ is added.        Choice (B)
